nodes.label: Take Over Service Icon (take-over.webp)
nodes.rationale: Glossy 3D-style icon: a blue house with white walls, four-pane window and door, surrounded by a red clockwise arrow on top and a blue arrow at the bottom forming a cycle. The circular arrows signal transfer/switching of an existing home loan (KPR take over / refinancing to another bank). Red and blue palette matches the RE/MAX brand colors.

nodes.label: Take Over KPR Service
nodes.rationale: Mortgage takeover: moving an existing KPR (home loan) from one bank to another, typically for a better interest rate. Represented by house + circular exchange arrows.
